source_caption:
Rhea Seehorn submitted the Pluribus pilot "We is us" episode for Emmy consideration and it earned her her first Emmy for Best Actress. After being nominated three times for Better Call Saul without a win, Seehorn finally got her moment.

Rhea Seehorn, who had previously received three Primetime Emmy nominations but had not won. She was nominated in 2022 and 2023 for outstanding supporting actress in a drama series for her role as Kim Wexler in Better Call Saul. In 2022, she also received a nomination for outstanding actress in a short-form comedy or drama series for playing Kris Latimer in AMC’s Cooper’s Bar.

Seehorn, who plays one of the last independent-thinking humans on Earth in the Vince Gilligan-created series, became emotional while accepting the award.Sorry, this is me on a beta blocker. It’s pretty bad,” Seehorn said as she took the stage.
